THE CAUSE IS SQUASH-MERGE: the squashed commit is not the branch head, so the branch head is never an ancestor of main. SO THE 2026-11-05 1.4 LESSON NEEDS ONE MORE TURN. That sitting established that branch EXISTENCE is not evidence of stranding. It is also true that branch NON-ANCESTRY IS NOT EVIDENCE OF STRANDING. The screen that bears the proposition is PR merge state or content membership in main, and I screened on both. NOTHING IS STRANDED. The risk falls on the MERGE re-fire, not on this batch. No row was designed today, so no price was owed, and I did not put a shape to the analyst to fill a spare slot. SEARCH BUDGET: ONE, AND IT IS DIRECTED, NOT DISCRETIONARY. 5.8(6) leaves the Roberts surface SPLIT with the two halves at different status: the Just Security limb was fired on 2026-11-05 and returned a measured null, and 5.8(6) EXPRESSLY BARS RE-FIRING THAT STRING; the EJIL:Talk limb is NOT FIRED AND NOT RESOLVED, and its fortnight closes 2026-11-15, NINE DAYS OUT. The one authorised search is spent on the EJIL:Talk limb and on nothing else. And I carry forward what the gate established about it: THE STANDING PROMPT MONITORS ONE URL, and the two-limb reading is a chairman's gloss, not a prompt term -- so a null on this limb is a null on a gloss, and may not be reported as closing the standing prompt. ZERO BUDGET UNCHANGED on the ARB/25/54 pleaded-asset question; fedlex.admin.ch and Swiss SR 0.975.247.2 in any formulation; ARB/12/1 and ARB/17/19; thread 11 (record only). PROVENANCE -- THE CORRECTED CONVENTION, FIFTH SITTING. Merging a request file to main is itself a push to analytics/fetch-requests/**, so the merge RE-FIRES this workflow and overwrites analytics/fetch-results/2026-11-06-daily.json with a later run id and fetched_at -- OR FAILS TO, as run 199 did, in which case the path keeps THIS reading. Either way THIS RECORD CITES THE BATCH BY COMMIT AND BLOB, which are immutable. I make no claim in the form 'X survives the re-fire' about any results file's own hash: it cannot. The results path is not a record of what a session observed; it is a record of the last time the relay SUCCEEDED against that request file. This sitting's own observation is recoverable only from the blob committed before its merge, and the record will name that blob. I propose no change to scripts/fetch_relay.py or to the workflow -- both are outside this session's merge scope and the question is the operator's. OPERATOR APPROVALS REMAIN PENDING, NOT GRANTED, and nothing on that list is built or applied here: the source_analytics.py patch, the health column, the polite_get diagnostic CLI, the IAReporter feed swap, the Kluwer source, the category signal, the build_graph fix, and any ledger amendment.
